spacy (misaki phonemizer dependency, install-breaking on Python 3.14)
blis Cython build failure on Python 3.14 (Cython<3.0 incompatible with NumPy headers)
nodes.rationale: spacy pulls in thinc -> blis, whose Cython .pyx files use syntax requiring Cython>=3.0; pip's build-isolation resolves an older Cython<3.0 for blis<0.8.0 causing a hard compile error (numpy Cython headers require Cython 3.0+), blocking spacy/thinc/misaki[en]/kokoro TTS pipeline install on Python 3.14.

pip_install_log4.txt — Python 3.11 venv install SUCCEEDS (kokoro 0.9.4, spacy 3.8.14, torch 2.13.0)
Python 3.11 virtualenv workaround for Kokoro/spacy install
nodes.rationale: Switching the venv interpreter from Python 3.14 to Python 3.11 resolves the blis/thinc Cython build failure (prebuilt wheels available for cp311, e.g. blis-1.3.3-cp311, murmurhash-cp311, curated_tokenizers-cp311), allowing kokoro 0.9.4, misaki 0.9.4, spacy 3.8.14, torch 2.13.0, and transformers 5.13.0 to install successfully without compiling blis from source.
